scope: Inventory of the live Flying Fish Studio scale registry and its linked Ecology movies, captured November 3, 2026. 31 registry records contain 27 videos, 3 static figures and 1 record without either. The 27 videos comprise 26 whose downloaded SHA-256 matches the published digest and 1 unpinned source. The 2 linked Ecology movies bring the main gallery to 33 records and 29 videos. The appendix retains 3 extra condition/chart movies, all 7 edited demo cuts, and 6 original print-geometry turntables listed in the snapshot. Records include simulations, analyses, geometry, controls, revisions and related-project reuse: this is not a count of independent validated flying-fish simulations.
method: Read the live snapshot, Studio/Simulation/Ecology source modules and all 31 underlying registry manifests. Fetched all 27 registry videos and both Ecology movies; checked HTTP responses, inspected media metadata, and computed hashes. No scientific model was rerun. Current Studio code adds every registry record matching the selected scale, including the soft-voxel reuse study and two epithelial-repair records. Some authored project summary text predates these newer records; this inventory follows the actual manifests and media. The two Ecology rows are reached through the linked Ecology page, not the 31-entry registry. The 6 print-form turntables were added during subsequent source-footage curation; their video digests match their render manifests, and those manifest digests match the frozen snapshot. Supplemental media scope is the source-manifest-linked extra movies, snapshot demo-cut list and print_forms turntables; it is not an exhaustive crawl of every binary in the repository.

proposed_scale_questions.molecular: Which molecular structures and interactions could support the intended material or signaling function?
proposed_scale_questions.macromolecular: How would protein assemblies transfer forces while keeping a fin light and tough?
proposed_scale_questions.subcellular: Can respiration and ATP supply meet the intended demand within oxygen and nutrient limits?
proposed_scale_questions.cellular: Which signals set cell fates, and when should responses stay local or spread?
proposed_scale_questions.tissue: How can growth, repair and material organization produce flexible, damage-tolerant tissue?
proposed_scale_questions.organ: Can fins carry load and change shape while other organs deliver enough oxygen?
proposed_scale_questions.neural: Which sensing, steering and reflex loops can recover from disturbances?
proposed_scale_questions.organism: How should launch, lift, drag, energy use and return to water work together?
proposed_scale_questions.developmental: Where, when and how much should each structure grow, and when should growth stop?
proposed_scale_questions.collective: Can local cues coordinate a group without collisions or unstable cascades?
proposed_scale_questions.ecological: What would change for predators, prey and food webs, and which fitness tradeoffs could emerge?

archive_note: Portable public edition of the November 3 source review. The 49 record IDs, source links, recorded-test prose, limits, and separately proposed questions are preserved. Machine-specific file paths and duplicate raw source payloads are omitted. Source links target public artifacts; no additional simulation or biological experiment was run for this archive. Eight unavailable site manifest paths are replaced by the corresponding public source-repository URLs; original URLs are retained in original_source_manifest_url and link-remapping.json.

records.title: Two-cell Delta-Notch replay (BioModels BIOMD0000001047)
records.recorded_test: Replays the published Collier two-cell Delta–Notch SBML model in three scenarios, plotting concentrations and phase portraits.
records.scope_limit: Two abstract cells in dimensionless units; no cell shape, tissue or fin is represented.
records.proposed_question: Could neighboring fin cells adopt complementary roles through lateral inhibition?
records.next_experiment: Measure signaling and cell-fate patterns in the target fin, then test whether this model explains perturbation responses.

records.title: Elastic fin-ray surrogate (Euler-Bernoulli cantilever)
records.recorded_test: Compares an Euler–Bernoulli cantilever finite-element surrogate with its closed-form bending solution as loads vary.
records.scope_limit: Geometry and material properties are assumed. The source checker flags 179 of 360 frames invalid; it is not a validated fin model.
records.proposed_question: How stiff must a fin ray be to carry load while remaining flexible?
records.next_experiment: Measure ray geometry, bending stiffness and loading; restrict the model to its valid deformation regime.

records.title: Bioelectric cell-voltage model: baseline, sodium-reduced and disconnected gap junctions
records.recorded_test: Compares baseline, reduced sodium conductance and disconnected gap junctions in a membrane-voltage/cable network model.
records.scope_limit: A generic electrical model. Numerical checks cover selected default and smooth passive cases, not a fish nervous system or every displayed condition.
records.proposed_question: When should an electrical signal stay local, and when should it spread across a cell network?
records.next_experiment: Measure target-cell membrane and junction conductances, then compare responses to channel and coupling perturbations.

records.title: Adhesion clutch mechanics (render of a simulation)
records.recorded_test: Renders a molecular-clutch trajectory and response sweep linking adhesion binding, force loading, rupture and actin flow.
records.scope_limit: Generic cell–matrix adhesion mechanics; transfer to a fish fin has not been established.
records.proposed_question: Can fin cells transmit force to their matrix without slipping or detaching?
records.next_experiment: Measure adhesion, traction and matrix response in the intended tissue; calibrate the clutch parameters against those data.

records.title: Glide trajectories at a fixed launch (point mass)
records.recorded_test: Compares point-mass glide trajectories from the same assumed 12 m/s speed and 1 m height over aerodynamic-coefficient ranges.
records.scope_limit: Constant coefficients and assumed launch conditions. The corrected common-launch comparison finds no robust winner.
records.proposed_question: Which geometry travels farther when every candidate starts from the same launch state?
records.next_experiment: Measure aerodynamic coefficients and compare candidates under matched launch conditions with uncertainty.

records.title: Reaction-diffusion field time series
records.recorded_test: Evolves generic Brusselator and Schnakenberg reaction–diffusion fields and compares resulting modes with linear predictions.
records.scope_limit: One finite-amplitude pattern emerges in a linearly stable case; the other dominant mode differs from the linear fastest mode. Neither is calibrated fin patterning.
records.proposed_question: Could spatial chemical signals set the spacing of fin structures?
records.next_experiment: Measure signaling wavelengths and kinetics, then test predicted spacing changes after controlled perturbations.

records.title: Single-ray basal sliding and curvature: published-equation reproduction
records.recorded_test: Reproduces published two-hemitrich ray equations: basal sliding changes curvature under fixed loading; 24 numerical comparisons agree with the same equations.
records.scope_limit: Bluegill-source, nondimensional single-ray mechanics. A published figure discrepancy remains unresolved; membrane, muscle, torsion and fluid coupling are absent.
records.proposed_question: Could controlled sliding at a ray's base steer fin curvature?
records.next_experiment: Measure flying-fish ray geometry and shear/bending properties, then compare curvature under known basal actuation and load.

records.title: 2D low-Reynolds flow past the N1 silhouette (lattice-Boltzmann), verdict FAIL
records.recorded_test: Runs low-Reynolds-number lattice-Boltzmann flow around a two-dimensional candidate silhouette.
records.scope_limit: Source verdict FAIL: stability/sign checks fail and refinement is incomplete. Infinite extrusion and low Reynolds number do not establish flight performance.
records.proposed_question: How might the fin outline alter flow separation and drag?
records.next_experiment: First pass reference and resolution tests, then use resolved three-dimensional geometry at relevant flow conditions.

records.title: BETSE bioelectric tissue patch: potassium permeability and gap-junction block
records.integrity: Source has no pinned video digest
records.recorded_test: Applies a potassium-permeability intervention to two cells in a 66-cell BETSE patch, comparing spread with and without gap-junction coupling.
records.scope_limit: Generic, uncalibrated patch; permeability is not a named channel. The registry supplies no expected video hash, so this video remains unpinned.
records.proposed_question: Can a local electrical intervention influence a larger developing tissue?
records.next_experiment: Measure target-tissue parameters and repeat local permeability perturbations with junction controls.

records.title: BETSE potassium-permeability sensitivity with gap-junction controls
records.recorded_test: Sweeps potassium permeability and gap-junction conditions in one shared 64-cell world, with seven conditions and a half-step numerical check.
records.scope_limit: One initialized world per condition, not biological replicates. No demonstrated link to Kcnj13 identity or fin morphology.
records.proposed_question: How robust is local versus collective voltage control when permeability changes?
records.next_experiment: Calibrate conductances and repeat across independent tissue layouts and measured parameter uncertainty.

records.title: Morpheus multicellular growth: cell cycle, division, cytokine feedback (baseline arm)
records.recorded_test: Shows the baseline of a generic cell-cycle, Potts-division and cytokine-feedback growth model; no-feedback and repeat-seed arms are available separately.
records.scope_limit: The early runs hit a 600-second compute cap around model time 0.46 of 2.0. This is not fish tissue or a complete growth trajectory.
records.proposed_question: Could feedback regulate cell number and tissue expansion during fin growth?
records.next_experiment: Measure proliferation and spatial growth under feedback perturbation, then calibrate and refine the model.

records.title: Collagen-mimetic trimer: three 100 ps molecular dynamics runs on an H100 (OpenMM, CUDA)
records.recorded_test: Runs three 100 ps classical molecular-dynamics trajectories of a synthetic collagen-mimetic trimer; the movie shows saved coordinates from one seed.
records.scope_limit: Short protein-fragment dynamics, not a stiffness measurement, equilibrium proof or demonstrated fin material. Shared starting structure, solvent and force field.
records.proposed_question: Could structural-protein properties help make a lightweight fin tough enough to bear load?
records.next_experiment: Test longer independent trajectories and calibrated mechanical perturbations, then connect them to measured tissue mechanics.

records.title: Collagen-mimetic trimer: three 900 ps continuations from the 100 ps states (OpenMM, CUDA)
records.recorded_test: Continues the three collagen-mimetic trajectories by 900 ps, reaching 1,000 ps total; the movie follows one continuation.
records.scope_limit: Conditional continuations, not independent new starts. Only one of three passes a short-window drift diagnostic; no equilibrium or modulus is established.
records.proposed_question: Do candidate structural-protein behaviors persist over a longer observation window?
records.next_experiment: Use independent starting conditions and validated force fields, with mechanical tests and explicit convergence criteria.

records.title: Generic zebrafish metabolic model: a steady-state flux balance with an assumed medium
records.recorded_test: Solves steady-state flux balance in a generic zebrafish metabolic network under an assumed nutrient medium, including an oxygen-uptake sweep.
records.scope_limit: The model can generate oxygen through a route involving near-uncapped vitamin uptake. Biomass flux is not measured respiration, ATP demand or flight capacity.
records.proposed_question: Can the intended behavior be supported within oxygen and nutrient constraints?
records.next_experiment: Measure tissue-specific uptake and energetic demand, constrain the medium and resolve the oxygen-generating route before interpreting energy budgets.

records.title: Collagen-mimetic trimer: 0.2 ps CPU setup run (OpenMM), the earlier short run
records.recorded_test: Renders an earlier 0.2 ps CPU setup trajectory of the collagen-mimetic trimer after 0.1 ps thermalization.
records.scope_limit: A setup check: temperature remains below the 300 K target. No equilibration, stiffness or protein-to-fin conversion is established.
records.proposed_question: Is the molecular setup suitable for asking a structural-material question?
records.next_experiment: Establish thermalization and stable numerical settings before longer, calibrated mechanical studies.

records.title: Predicted structure of zebrafish Kcnj13 (OpenFold2): a computed model, not an observation
records.recorded_test: Predicts an unrelaxed 362-residue zebrafish Kcnj13 monomer with OpenFold2 using a single-sequence/dummy-MSA setup.
records.scope_limit: Mean pLDDT 52.9 and pTM 0.27; no membrane, tetramer, conductance, gating or phenotype test. No video or poster is published for this registry row.
records.proposed_question: Could a candidate ion-channel structure help frame experiments on electrical growth control?
records.next_experiment: Improve sequence/assembly context, then measure channel function and tissue effects rather than infer them from this structure.

records.title: Candidate N1 as a 3D model: path-traced turntable
records.recorded_test: Shows a path-traced turntable of candidate N1 geometry assembled from fitted dimensions and explicit artistic/geometric assumptions.
records.scope_limit: A geometry illustration, not simulated flight, a constructed organism or a performance result.
records.proposed_question: Do the proposed body and fin proportions form a coherent candidate to test?
records.next_experiment: Check dimensions against specimens and manufacturing constraints, then use the same geometry in validated mechanics and flow tests.

records.title: 3D flow past the fish3d candidate, Re = 1000, 128 cells along the body (WaterLily, H100)
records.recorded_test: Computes three-dimensional flow around the fixed candidate at Re = 1,000, with 128 cells along body length; the movie shows velocity midplanes.
records.scope_limit: The sphere reference check fails, and fins are subgrid. This is exploratory flow footage, not trustworthy force or flight-performance prediction.
records.proposed_question: Where might wakes form around this body and fin geometry?
records.next_experiment: Pass reference cases and resolve the fins before interpreting force differences at relevant Reynolds numbers.

records.title: 3D flow past the fish3d candidate, Re = 1000, 192 cells along the body (WaterLily, H100)
records.recorded_test: Repeats the fixed-body Re = 1,000 flow computation at 192 cells along body length.
records.scope_limit: The same failed reference applies, and fins remain subgrid. A finer grid alone does not validate the model.
records.proposed_question: Do apparent flow structures persist as spatial resolution improves?
records.next_experiment: Continue a documented refinement ladder with resolved fin thickness and passing reference cases.

records.title: Morpheus full-horizon logger chart (t to 2.0): a chart of logged counts, not a spatial tissue movie
records.recorded_test: Charts logged growth through model time 2.0: baseline 256 cells, no-feedback 128 and repeat-seed 263.
records.scope_limit: A chart of a generic model's logged counts, not a spatial tissue movie; no fish calibration or physical time mapping.
records.proposed_question: Does a feedback effect on growth persist beyond the earliest divisions?
records.next_experiment: Compare measured growth trajectories with repeated, calibrated model runs and numerical-refinement checks.

records.title: Rhythm-generator controller driving a designed joint servo (eight segments)
records.recorded_test: Drives an eight-segment designed joint servo with phase/amplitude oscillators; tests tracking, kick recovery and feedback/coupling ablations.
records.scope_limit: Coarse independent mechanical joints, not somites or a validated fish nervous system; hydrodynamics is absent.
records.proposed_question: Can coordinated body actuation recover from disturbances?
records.next_experiment: Measure body kinematics and torque, then connect the controller to a calibrated coupled body–fluid model.

records.title: Erk trigger waves and wave-gated growth on one regenerating zebrafish scale
records.recorded_test: Models ERK trigger waves and assumed wave-gated growth on a regenerating zebrafish scale over 120 hours.
records.scope_limit: Some source-band comparisons pass and others fail. This is scale regeneration, not microscopy, initial fin development or established flying-fish transfer.
records.proposed_question: Could signaling waves coordinate controlled repair or regrowth after surface damage?
records.next_experiment: Measure signaling waves and growth in the target tissue, and test whether the proposed coupling predicts perturbation outcomes.

records.title: Static aeroelastic coupling of the fins: 36 arms, bending-only torsion-rigid scaffold
records.recorded_test: Compares rigid, frozen-load and recomputed-load cases across 36 steady bending/aerodynamic arms.
records.scope_limit: Assumed constant stiffness, torsion-rigid scaffold and steady flow. The tiny nominal range effect is not resolved by the mesh check or a demonstrated benefit.
records.proposed_question: Does bending change aerodynamic performance enough to matter?
records.next_experiment: Measure fin stiffness, validate flow and trim, and resolve the effect above numerical uncertainty.

records.title: Aeroelastic fidelity ladder: 45 native arms, no effect magnitude resolved
records.recorded_test: Runs 45 arms across five lattices and three contexts to test resolution of aeroelastic effects.
records.scope_limit: No effect magnitude is resolved; all three engineering decisions remain undetermined despite consistent signs in some comparisons.
records.proposed_question: Does an apparent flexibility advantage survive a stricter fidelity check?
records.next_experiment: Refine span/chord resolution and validate the physics until uncertainty is small enough to distinguish candidates.

records.title: Neural cellular automaton fin pattern, original run: 0 of 48 predicates
records.recorded_test: Trains local neural cellular-automaton rules toward a fin-shaped design raster and tests growth/repair predicates: 0 of 48 pass.
records.scope_limit: Computational grid channels, not biochemical states or DNA. The original run does not meet its design predicates.
records.proposed_question: Can local rules build and repair a desired pattern?
records.next_experiment: Predefine independent initialization, damage, recovery and persistence tests; biological implementation is a separate missing connection.

records.title: Neural cellular automaton fin pattern, corrected seed placement: 32 of 48 predicates, left-half recovery 0 of 12
records.recorded_test: Changes one initial seed position in the NCA setup: 32 of 48 predicates pass, but left-half recovery remains 0 of 12.
records.scope_limit: The same tests were reused, not a fresh held-out evaluation. No biological implementation is shown.
records.proposed_question: How sensitive is a developmental rule to its initial spatial conditions?
records.next_experiment: Evaluate untouched initializations, patterns and damage cases with preregistered success and persistence criteria.

records.title: NCA curriculum repair/persistence tradeoff: 89/192 design predicates
records.recorded_test: Compares a staged damage curriculum with baseline NCA training: 89 of 192 predicates pass overall; baseline 45/96, curriculum 44/96.
records.scope_limit: Some repair improves while persistence worsens; no aggregate benefit. The movie emphasizes a repair case, not the long-term endpoint.
records.proposed_question: Can a pattern repair damage without sacrificing durable form?
records.next_experiment: Evaluate repair and long-term persistence together on independent held-out damage cases.

records.title: Observed-data update: added specimens worsen held-out transfer
records.recorded_test: Re-fits fin/body scaling with additional preserved-specimen rows; added data worsens held-out species transfer and triggers recomputation instead of stale reuse.
records.scope_limit: An analysis of existing observed data, not newly collected measurements or proof that a designed fish works. The registry publishes a static figure only.
records.proposed_question: Will a fin-size relationship transfer to a new species or body size?
records.next_experiment: Collect independent morphology measurements and evaluate cross-species predictions with explicit uncertainty.

records.title: Soft-voxel toy body under a travelling actuation wave (Voxelyze)
records.recorded_test: Animates saved states of a soft-voxel ground-contact toy under a travelling actuation wave from a related tissue-microcarrier reuse study.
records.scope_limit: Not fish, tissue or fluid locomotion. A zero-gravity control misses its bound and spatial refinement is not converged; other controls used a different actuation pattern.
records.proposed_question: Could a travelling actuation wave coordinate a deformable body?
records.next_experiment: Use measured tissue mechanics and appropriate fluid/contact physics, then repeat controls on the exact actuation pattern being evaluated.

records.title: Epithelial gap in a Cellular Potts model: the same wound closes, or is left open when motility is off
records.recorded_test: Shows actual Cellular Potts lattice states and logged tracks as a gap closes in a related epithelial-repair model.
records.scope_limit: Generic uncalibrated two-dimensional tissue model; several checks fail or remain incomplete. No fish-specific repair or clinical outcome is established.
records.proposed_question: Could cell migration close a damaged fin surface?
records.next_experiment: Measure target-tissue motility and adhesion, then compare model and observed closure under matched perturbations.

records.title: Epithelial gap in a Cellular Potts model: the same wound closes, or is left open when motility is off — protrusion-disabled control
records.recorded_test: Shows the paired protrusion/motility-disabled control of the epithelial gap model, where the wound is left open.
records.scope_limit: A model ablation, not biological evidence. No purse-string mechanism is represented; the same calibration/check limitations apply.
records.proposed_question: Does surface closure require cell motility rather than another repair mechanism?
records.next_experiment: Compare matched motility and contractility perturbations in the target tissue, with model mechanisms kept distinguishable.

records.title: Passive glide versus bounded fin feedback
records.integrity: Downloaded bytes hashed; local source provenance retained
records.recorded_test: Replays saved MuJoCo states comparing passive glide with bounded fin feedback after an assumed airborne release.
records.scope_limit: Assumed 20 m/s release and bounded aerodynamic-angle domain; no water launch or empirical validation. Passive stops at water earlier, so endpoints are not equal landing times.
records.proposed_question: Can fin feedback maintain a controlled glide after release?
records.next_experiment: Measure forces and control response, then compare matched releases and equal evaluation horizons within the validated aerodynamic domain.

records.title: Eight-fish local-cue escape scenario and no-neighbor ablation
records.integrity: Downloaded bytes hashed; local source provenance retained
records.recorded_test: Replays an eight-fish local-neighbor-cue scenario against a no-neighbor ablation using saved simulator states and explicit cue/response rules.
records.scope_limit: Assumed delays, thresholds and fin torques; stops at an aerodynamic-domain limit. No wake/contact model, calibrated ecology or survival/fitness result.
records.proposed_question: Could local cues coordinate a group's escape response?
records.next_experiment: Measure cue detection, response delays and flight behavior, then test the model against independent collective-response data.

records.title: Metabolism o2 sweep
records.recorded_test: Oxygen sweep of the same generic zebrafish flux-balance model.
records.scope_limit: Chart animation; not measured respiration or independent evidence of flight capacity.
records.proposed_question: Can oxygen supply constrain the intended energetic demand?
records.next_experiment: Constrain measured medium/uptake and resolve the model oxygen-generating route.

records.title: Morpheus nofeedback
records.recorded_test: No-cytokine-feedback arm of the early generic multicell model.
records.scope_limit: Related arm of the same capped early run; not an independent fish-growth result.
records.proposed_question: Does growth change when feedback is removed?
records.next_experiment: Measure the matching perturbation and compare calibrated full trajectories.

records.title: Morpheus seed repeat
records.recorded_test: Repeat-seed arm of the early generic multicell model.
records.scope_limit: Related arm of the same capped early run; not an independent fish-growth result.
records.proposed_question: How much does the growth result depend on initialization?
records.next_experiment: Repeat independent initializations and compare with observed variability.
